agent.unit:
# Managed by Orbit: agent
[Unit]
Description=Orbit Node agent
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/orbit-agent
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
User=root
Group=root
SupplementaryGroups=orbit-env
CapabilityBoundingSet=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=tmpfs
BindReadOnlyPaths=-/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew
BindReadOnlyPaths=-/home/orbit/.vite-plus
BindReadOnlyPaths=-/home/orbit/.local/share/vite-plus
PrivateTmp=yes
MemoryMax=128M
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

files.content:
[orbit-gateway]
user = orbit
group = orbit
listen = /run/php/orbit-gateway.sock
listen.owner = orbit
listen.group = caddy
listen.mode = 0660
pm = ondemand
pm.max_children = 8
pm.process_idle_timeout = 10s
pm.max_requests = 100
request_terminate_timeout = 600s
chdir = /home/orbit/swamp-proof/src/apps/gateway
catch_workers_output = yes
clear_env = yes
security.limit_extensions = .php
env[HOME] = /home/orbit
env[ORBIT_HOME] = /home/orbit/.orbit
env[PATH] = /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
php_admin_value[opcache.validate_timestamps] = 1
php_admin_value[opcache.revalidate_freq] = 0
php_admin_value[max_execution_time] = 600

[Unit]
Description=Orbit runtime hibernator
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=orbit
WorkingDirectory=/home/orbit/swamp-proof/src/apps/gateway
Environment=ORBIT_HOME=/home/orbit/.orbit
ExecStart="/usr/bin/php8.5" "/home/orbit/swamp-proof/src/apps/gateway/artisan" "orbit:runtime-hibernator"

# Managed by Orbit.
[Journal]
SystemMaxUse=256M
SystemKeepFree=1024M
RuntimeMaxUse=64M
MaxRetentionSec=7day

# Managed by Orbit. Daily Laravel logs rotate through Laravel itself.
"/home/orbit/swamp-proof/src/apps/gateway/storage/logs/laravel.log" {
    su orbit orbit
    daily
    maxsize 32M
    rotate 7
    missingok
    notifempty
    compress
    copytruncate
}

# Managed by Orbit.
[Timer]
OnCalendar=
OnCalendar=hourly
AccuracySec=1m
RandomizedDelaySec=0
Persistent=false

units.name: orbit-agent-view.service
units.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit agent view subscriber
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=orbit
WorkingDirectory=/home/orbit/swamp-proof/src/apps/gateway
Environment=ORBIT_HOME=/home/orbit/.orbit
ExecStart="/usr/bin/php8.5" "/home/orbit/swamp-proof/src/apps/gateway/artisan" "orbit:agent-view"
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
MemoryMax=256M

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

units.name: orbit-runtime-hibernator.timer
units.unit:
[Unit]
Description=Orbit runtime hibernator timer

[Timer]
OnBootSec=2min
OnUnitActiveSec=600s
Persistent=true
Unit=orbit-runtime-hibernator.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
